function: Learned part (DQN) only picks the two IoVs for BS association and NOMA pairing (p. 5); power and BD-RIS phase use convex and manifold optimization (pp. 7-8).
notes: Title and DOI on p. 1 match. Reason above_phy. p. 5: "In this section, we adopt a DRL approach to solve the IoV" association problem, choosing two IoVs from M for NOMA. p. 7: "convex solvers, such as CVX in MATLAB" for the power allocation. p. 8: "this problem efficiently, we adopt a manifold optimization" for the BD-RIS phase shifts. p. 10: "exploring the integration of AI techniques for optimizing" the RIS reconfiguration is left as future work. No physical-layer decision is learned, so the exception for a joint physical-layer and above-layer decision does not apply. no_learning is not used because the method does contain a learned component (the DQN), which acts above the physical layer.
